about_the_game:
Blast, Boost, and Ascend!.

In Rise To Mayhem, you play as an elite jetpack soldier sent to ascend a mysterious alien tower that erupted from the Earth. Armed with powerful weapons, quick reflexes, and a thirst for chaos, you'll fight swarms of enemies, dodge deadly traps, defeat massive bosses, and gather powerful upgrades as you climb ever higher.

Your mission: survive as long as possible, rise as high as you can, and rack up the highest score before you're overwhelmed.

With intense pixel-art action, satisfying power-ups, and endless replayability, Rise to Mayhem delivers a retro-inspired, adrenaline-fueled experience for fans of arcade shooters and roguelites.

 Features:

  • Jetpack-powered vertical shooting action

  • Procedurally generated tower and enemy encounters

  • Powerful upgrades and character-enhancing power-ups

  • Brutal boss battles that test your reflexes and skill

  • High score chasing with survival-based progression

  • Crisp pixel art visuals inspired by retro classics

  • Steam Achievements and full controller support

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel i3 / AMD FX or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000, NVIDIA 600 series, or AMD HD 7000 series)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit OS required. Performance may vary depending on distribution and driver support.
